title: Share of Americans with little or no local news coverage

source.name: State of Local News 2025
source.publisher: Medill Local News Initiative, Northwestern University

notes: Medill's 2025 report estimates 50 million Americans live in counties with either no local news source or just one. The percent share here is calculated against the U.S. Census Bureau's ~335 million 2024 national population estimate (50M / 335M ≈ 15%); the 50-million figure itself is the report's own number, the percent conversion is this channel's calculation.
